stories.title: Sankey: Pros returning to school 'fuels disruption'
stories.summary: SEC commissioner Greg Sankey asked a judge to uphold NCAA rules that prevent athletes from returning to play in college.

stories.title: Lakers minority owner not selling his 4% stake
stories.summary: One of the Lakers' minority owners, Dr. Patrick Soon-Shiong, has no plans to sell his 4% stake in the team, his attorney told ESPN.

stories.title: Sources: M's calling up top prospect Anderson
stories.summary: The Mariners are calling up left-hander Kade Anderson, the No. 1 pitching prospect in baseball, to start against the Cubs on Saturday, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Too grand: DeGrom 2nd-fastest to 2K strikeouts
stories.summary: Rangers pitcher Jacob deGrom became the second-fastest pitcher to reach 2,000 career strikeouts, reaching the milestone in just 1,660⅓ innings.

stories.title: McIlroy shoots bogey-free 64, shares BMW lead
stories.summary: Rory McIlroy played bogey-free at Bellerive for a 6-under 64 that gave him a share of the lead Thursday in the BMW Championship.
